name: Take Desktop Screenshot
description: Captures a screenshot of the current screen or active window and saves it to the Pictures directory.
spoken_confirmation_template: Took a screenshot and saved it to your Pictures directory.

name: Toggle Media Playback
description: Controls audio and video playback (play, pause, stop, toggle) for active MPRIS DBus media players (Spotify, YouTube in Firefox/Chrome, VLC, MPV) with optional player targeting.

player.description: Target player or app keyword (e.g. 'spotify', 'youtube', 'firefox', 'chrome', 'vlc', 'mpv'). Omit to target all active players.

name: Adjust Volume
description: Increases, decreases, or mutes master system audio volume on Linux.

execution.template: wpctl set-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ {action} || pamixer -t || amixer set Master 5%+

name: Lock Desktop Screen
description: Locks the current desktop session immediately for security.

name: System Power Control (Shutdown / Reboot / Suspend)
description: Powers off, shuts down, reboots, suspends, or locks the system.

name: Search Desktop Files
description: Searches for files matching a query name in the user's home folder.

query.description: File name pattern or search term.

name: Check System Status
description: Displays current system uptime, RAM memory usage, and CPU information.

name: Open Terminal
description: Launches a new terminal emulator window on the desktop.

name: Search Web for Information
description: Performs an active web search and returns text snippets into stdout. Use this tool when you need to look up installation commands, package IDs (like Flatpak app IDs), system documentation, or web information before executing terminal commands.

query.description: Search query text (e.g. 'flatpak install discord command flathub').

name: Update User Memory Profile
description: Updates or adds a user preference, technical tool, or setting directly into the persistent memory profile (~/.config/jarvis/user_profile.md).

key.description: Profile key to update (e.g. 'Preferred IDE / Editors', 'Active Project', 'Preferred Voice').

fact.description: Optional direct preference statement (e.g. 'Preferred text editor is Sublime Text').

examples.user_prompt: Set my preferred IDE in memory to VS Code

name: Get Current Time & Date
description: Retrieves current local system time, date, day of week, and ISO timestamp. Use this tool whenever you need to know what time or date it is, or to compute relative durations for timers and focus sessions.

name: Execute Terminal Command
description: Executes a bash terminal command on the user's system to perform file system operations (creating directories with mkdir, writing files, reading file content with cat/grep, process inspection) when no specialized tool exists.

command.description: The exact bash command string to execute (e.g. 'mkdir -p ~/Documents/Projects', 'echo "hello" > ~/test.txt', 'cat ~/.config/app.conf').

explanation.description: Short 1-sentence reason explaining why this shell command is necessary.

examples.user_prompt: Create a directory called Projects in my Documents folder

expected_args.explanation: Creating directory Projects in Documents folder

name: Macro & Workspaces Controller
description: Creates, runs, modifies, or lists multi-step desktop automation macros and workspace modes (such as Gaming Mode, Work Mode, or Usual Apps). Steps can be app names, bash commands, or CLI operations (like 'locked-in start -d 2h').

macro_name.description: Name or ID of the macro (e.g. 'gaming_mode', 'usual_apps', 'work_mode').

steps.description: List of app names or shell commands to run in the macro (e.g. ['steam', 'discord', 'locked-in start -d 2h']).

step.description: Single step or command string to add/remove.

directory.description: Optional working directory path for the macro (e.g. '~/Documents/Jarvis').

name: Close Desktop Application
description: Closes, terminates, or exits a running desktop application (such as Steam, Spotify, Discord, Firefox, VS Code) by application name.

app_name.description: Name of the application to close (e.g. 'steam', 'spotify', 'discord', 'firefox', 'code').

name: Hand a Task to Claude Code
description: Hands a multi-step computer task to Claude Code, an agent that can read and edit files, run shell commands, and search the web on its own until the task is done (risky steps wait for the user's OK). Use it for installs, setting things up, organizing or editing files, coding, and research that needs several steps. Do NOT use it for single desktop actions that another tool already does (media, volume, apps, timers, macros).

task.description: The whole task in plain words, with every detail the user gave (names, paths, preferences). Claude Code can't see this conversation.

examples.user_prompt: Install the Jane Street Socratic skill for Claude Code

expected_args.task: Install the Jane Street socratic-tutor skill (github.com/janestreet/agent_skills) into ~/.claude/skills so Claude Code can use it.
